text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Lansdowne Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Lansdowne Avenue. During the course of the investigation, it was noted that there is a discrepancy between posted signs and the by-law. Recommendation 2 will correct the inconsistency.

City Council on May 11 and 12, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Lansdowne Avenue, between a point 180.7 metres north of Whytock Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further north. 2. City Council amend the existing maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect on both sides of Lansdowne Avenue, between College Street and Whytock Avenue to be in effect on the west side.
